bugClass.title: Actionable row disappears before its confirmation is visible
bugClass.cause: The view uses membership in the pending list to control the lifetime of a row that also displays the action result. Hiding an answered ID, optimistically removing an item, or replacing the list after a refresh can therefore unmount the row or its enclosing section before the user sees the acknowledged choice and the row finishes its exit.
bugClass.criteria: Follow a successful answer or dismissal from the selected state through the next render. Count a match if any one path hides the row or its section too early: an answered-ID check suppresses it, an optimistic update removes it, or a refresh supplies a list that omits it. Check the last item in a section as well as an item with siblings. The deciding evidence is that removal prevents a visible confirmation followed by a completed collapse. A filter or refresh alone is insufficient.

candidates.evidence: TrackerInboxRows.svelte lines 81–88 add the review key to answered and start onchanged() alongside a 900 ms timer. Lines 93–94 render shown with a 320 ms exit, or 0 ms under reduced motion. The timer delays clearing active. The excerpt omits how answered or the refresh affects shown, so removal before visible acknowledgment remains unverified.

VaultModel+Queues.swift lines 76–83 and 89–92 show remove() deleting matching request IDs and incrementing queueRevision. The excerpt gives neither the caller that triggers removal nor the view that consumes the queue, so it cannot establish whether removal interrupts a row’s acknowledgment or exit.

TrackerInboxChoices.svelte lines 41–52 show that confirming a pending choice clears `pending` and calls `onpick(number)`. The choices section renders only while `flag.state === 'open'`. The excerpt omits the callback implementation and the row that would display the acknowledged choice, so the order of acknowledgment and removal is unknown.

TrackerInboxWrites.svelte lines 43–59 show that a discardable write awaiting confirmation offers a button calling `discard(write.intentId)`. Each row depends on membership in `writes`, and an empty list shows the sync message. The successful discard handler is outside the excerpt, leaving both row removal and acknowledgment timing unresolved.

MacTrackerInboxService.ts lines 127–130 show that `readRows()` requests all statuses and returns only items passing `visible(item)`. The excerpt omits the predicate, the caller that would refresh after an answer, and the view consuming the rows. It therefore leaves open whether a successful answer removes its row before acknowledgment.

trackerInbox.ts lines 68–70 copy all rows for the 'all' filter and otherwise keep rows in the selected bucket. A row that changes buckets would drop out of its former bucket view. The excerpt shows neither a successful answer causing that change nor a render that cuts off the row’s confirmation or collapse.

threadComments.svelte.ts lines 23–30 replace pending with drafts whose kind is 'pending' after a load for the same project. A previously listed draft can drop out on reload. Lines 35–42 show post clearing acknowledged at the start, but omit its success path. No shown render ties confirmation or collapse to the draft’s continued membership.

GameCheckpointEditor.svelte lines 22–33 define without(list, i), which would omit the element at index i when called with a matching index. The visible condition and action editors call replace. The excerpt shows no caller connecting without to a successful dismissal or to the next render of a row displaying its result.
